style: Dark-gold editorial brand system (matches piece-02-seo / google-3-pack-stat in this same video). Abstracted, stylized search-UI chassis — a rounded search bar + generic map-pack result rows, NOT a real captured page and NOT a Google logo/wordmark/brand-color reproduction — building to the moment genuine buying intent resolves into a trust choice: the homeowner skims past an ad row and lands on the best-reviewed organic result.

customize.note: Category set to 'webpage' per the brief's own framing (Google-search / UI-animation moment), but this is a hand-authored stylized mockup, NOT a live `hyperframes capture` of a real URL — asset_needs is empty and Step 2 (source) is skipped, matching the sibling google-3-pack-stat's established convention of an abstracted, non-Google chassis (generic magnifier glyph, generic map-pin, generic star-rating dots, placeholder name-bars) rather than a literal trademark reproduction. Searched the catalog for 'search engine results page UI mockup', 'typewriter search bar typing text', 'cursor click selection highlight card', 'map pin business listing card stagger reveal' — nothing in the hosted registry matches this exact composite UI chassis, so it is hand-authored, directly reusing the visual grammar (search-bar chassis, result-row chassis, pin/star iconography, color tokens, type scale) already established by google-3-pack-stat in this same project for visual continuity across the video.

ad_row.note: generic placeholder ad result, no pin, dimmer weight — recedes after appearing to read as 'skimmed past, not the thing that earns trust'

results.note: the trust-signal moment lands here — best-rated organic result gets the highlight + click

highlights.label: ad result appears, then visibly recedes/dims — skimmed past
organic map-pack rows stagger in with star ratings
cursor lands + click-ripple + glow highlight on the best-reviewed row — the trust choice

scenes.beat: Search bar sets the scene — real intent, typed by hand
scenes.description: Abstract rounded-rect search-bar chassis (dark card, gold hairline border, generic magnifier glyph — no Google wordmark/logo/colors) centered upper-frame. Query types in via typewriter caret: 'roof repair near me'.
scenes.motion: scale_grow entrance (back.out) on the bar chassis 0.15-0.65s, caret blink loop (finite repeat) from 0.55s, typewriter reveal of the query text 0.65-1.95s.

scenes.beat: Results resolve into a trust choice — not an ad, a decision
scenes.description: Search bar settles smaller at top (query now static, no caret). A dim, small 'AD' result appears first then visibly recedes/dims — skimmed past. Three generic map-pack rows (pin + placeholder name-bar + star-dot rating) stagger in below. The best-rated row (row-1, 5 stars) gets a cursor landing + click-ripple + gold glow highlight — the trust-signal moment. A short label lands beneath: "THEY'RE NOT INTERRUPTED. THEY'RE CHOOSING." Final state holds to the end for a clean cut back to host footage.
scenes.motion: search-bar settle (crossfade to smaller static state) at 2.6s; ad-row slide/fade in at 2.75s then recede (opacity down) at 3.45s; 3 result rows slide_bottom stagger (0.22s apart) from 3.7s, star-dots pop back.out per row; cursor-badge scale_punch + click-ripple + row-1 border/glow intensify at 6.2-6.8s; trust-label fade_up at 6.9s; hold from ~7.35s to 9.6s.
